facts.fact: The Office of the Prime Minister, through the Department Public Service IT Management, drafted an Interoperability Framework for Namibia modelled on Estonia's X-Road, with stakeholder consultations held in 2016.

The ministry's expression of interest states the Government of Namibia has adopted Estonia's X-Road as its Interoperability Framework; no adoption date is given, so the document's published date is used.
